_doc: Java port of tasks/ladder.json: per-rung check subsets. Score denominator = weights of the listed ids only, FIXED per rung.

L1_migration_entity.description: Scaffold account-service from an empty workspace: a Flyway migration and a money-correct Account entity with non-negative balance constraints, proven by a repository test.

L2_one_endpoint.description: Expose a full account/deposit HTTP contract behind docker compose, backed by an OpenAPI spec and HALF_EVEN-rounded deposits.

L3_point_in_time.description: Add orders with immediate fills and point-in-time holdings queries with an exclusive asOf boundary, replaying sells correctly.

L4_state_machine.description: Implement the order state machine (NEW -> FILLED/CANCELLED) with idempotent order creation via an Idempotency-Key header.

L5_second_service.description: Split the platform into three independently-built services (account, order, market) that talk to each other only over HTTP, each with its own schema.

L6_compose_health.description: Bring up three services under docker compose with real Docker healthchecks and dependency ordering, surviving a slow-starting Postgres.

L7_full_platform.description: The full production trading platform end to end: microservices, a React frontend, an OpenAPI contract, and every correctness/money/state-machine rule, graded entirely from a clean checkout.

L3p_point_in_time.description: Same feature as L3 (orders + point-in-time holdings), but run plan-first: write docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md as 3-6 verifiable subtasks before the implementation phase begins.
